description: Everything Realty.Bingo holds on one property (property_id) or listing (listing_id): attributes, current and other listings, listing contact as published, features with evidence, identity-resolution confidence, recent changes and any stored rent/value estimates (labelled as estimates). refresh: true fetches the latest record if the stored one is over a day old.

refresh.description: Fetch the latest listing record from its source if the stored one is over 24 hours old (uses a live refresh).
